brief: Two separate pairs of bases, the pairs joined to each other only with side connectors.

requirements.requirement: Two separate pairs of bases (four bases total arranged as 2+2)
requirements.evidence: 4 bases present: piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full, piece:0,1,0;full, piece:1,1,0;full — arranged as pair A (0,0)-(1,0) and pair B (0,1)-(1,1)

requirements.requirement: Pairs joined to each other only with side connectors (no other joining method)
requirements.evidence: All adjacency bridged by side-connector family: connector:0#0,0|1,0 (within pair A), connector:0#0,1|1,1 (within pair B), plus connector:0#0,0|0,1 and connector:0#1,0|1,1 joining the two pairs. No other connector types or shared structures; check_build ok and meshClash clear

finish.summary: Build forms 2x2 block of 4 full bases as two horizontal pairs, with each intra-pair edge and both inter-pair edges joined by side-connector-double parts (4 connectors total). No other joining used; verify passes with meshClash clear.

lines.key: pvc-section-double  (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
